title: 第5章 擎天盟第6章 龙帝的神龙臂
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
“小子，你手中的果子，我们擎天盟看上了，识相的，老老实实交出来，否则当心丢了小命。”
在林白的背后，不知道什么时候出现了十几个面色不善的男男女女。
这群人虽然有十几个，但是武道修为却是不高，五个武道四重，七个武道三重，两个武道二重。
“擎天盟？”林白疑惑了一下。
一路上走来，林白在青灵山脉中也遇见了不少的人，也听说过擎天盟的事情。
在青灵山脉中，有两大联盟，一个是斩妖盟，一个是擎天盟。
这两个联盟，都是专门为猎杀妖兽而组建的，加入盟内，可以获得许多的资源，比如说青灵山脉什么地方危险，什么地方妖兽成群，什么地方有真武境级别的妖兽，都能知道。
如果知道了这些信息，就不会像林白现在这样，一个劲的在青灵山脉中乱闯了。
原本，林白打算得到孕灵果后，便找寻一个联盟加入，得到一些高等级妖兽的下落，前往猎杀。
擎天盟内，那一个领头的男子很不耐烦的对林白嚷嚷道：“我特么的让你把果子拿过来，你是耳朵聋了啊，没听见老子的话？”
林白面色一冷，将三枚孕灵果收入了怀中，说道：“想要果子啊，自己来拿啊！”
孕灵果是林白千辛万苦，在青灵山脉中游荡了半个多月，这才找到的地方，他才不会轻易的交出来。
林白冷冷道：“我劝你们现在离开，我可以既往不咎，如果你们非要送死，我不介意送你们一程！”
“哈哈哈，这人是脑子有病吧，你才武道四重，而我们有五个武道四重的武者，你拿什么跟我们斗？“
“真是笑死我们了，居然还想杀我们？”
“兄弟们，既然他这么不识抬举，那我们就让他见识一下咱们擎天盟的厉害！”
擎天盟的武者，一声耻笑之后，个个带着戏谑的眼神，一副惬意的走向了林白。
在他们看来，自己阵营中，五个武道四重的武者，难道连一个武道四重的武者都收拾不了吗？
这林白，已经是死了。
“冥顽不灵！”林白亮出了斩灵剑！

“杀！”
“黑胡掏心！”
“猛牛拳！”
“秋风剑法！”
“横扫千军！”
“修罗掌！”
……
这十几个擎天盟的武者，完全是如同在围杀一只妖兽一般，对着林白便冲杀上来。
“既然你们要来送死，我就成全你们！”
“一剑飙血！”
快如闪电一般的剑光，在众人之中挥洒开来。
“啊！啊~~”
“饶命啊！”
“大侠饶命啊！”
一剑出，林白瞬间击杀了三位武道四重的武者。
“血流成河！”
一大片的剑光斩落下去，林白将剩下来的其他武者，全部斩杀在剑下。
泣血剑法，毕竟还是黄级九品的武技，威力不可小觑，就连刚才的白头雕，武道修为高出林白一个境界，都还是死在了林白的手中。
可想而知，这泣血剑法是何等的厉害。
而这些擎天盟的武者，施展的剑法，拳法，掌法，基本上都是黄级一品，黄级二品的武技，根本是不入流的。

林白将擎天盟其他的武者斩杀后，唯独只剩下那擎天盟领头的男子，并没有死去，只是受了一点轻伤。
content_en:
"Boy, we, the Qingtian Alliance, are interested in the fruit in your hand. If you are wise, hand it over honestly, otherwise you may lose your life."
Behind Lin Bai, a dozen men and women with evil looks appeared at some point.
Although there are more than a dozen people in this group, their martial arts cultivation is not high. There are five at the fourth level of martial arts, seven at the third level of martial arts, and two at the second level of martial arts.
"Qingtian Alliance?" Lin Bai was confused.
Along the way, Lin Bai also met many people in the Qingling Mountains and heard about the Qingtian Alliance.
In the Qingling Mountains, there are two major alliances, one is the Demon Slayer Alliance and the other is the Qingtian Alliance.
These two alliances were formed specifically for hunting monster beasts. By joining the alliance, you can get a lot of resources. For example, you can know where the Qingling Mountains are dangerous, where there are hordes of monsters, and where there are monsters at the True Martial Realm level.
If he knew this information, he wouldn't be like Lin Bai now, running around in the Qingling Mountains.
Originally, Lin Bai planned to find an alliance to join after getting the pregnancy spirit fruit, get the whereabouts of some high-level monsters, and go hunt them.
In the Qingtian League, the leading man shouted to Lin Bai impatiently: "I asked you to bring the fruit. Are you deaf? Didn't you hear what I said?"
Lin Bai's face turned cold, he took the three Pregnancy Spirit Fruits into his arms and said, "If you want the fruits, come and get them yourself!"
The Pregnant Spirit Fruit was found by Lin Bai after working hard for more than half a month wandering around the Qingling Mountains. He would not hand it over easily.
Lin Bai said coldly: "I advise you to leave now. I can forget about the past. If you insist on dying, I don't mind giving you a ride!"
"Hahaha, this person must be mentally ill. You are only at the fourth level of martial arts, and we have five warriors at the fourth level of martial arts. What are you going to do to fight us?"
"You really laughed at us, and you actually want to kill us?"
"Brothers, since he is so ignorant of praise, let's let him see the power of our Qingtian Alliance!"
The warriors of the Qingtian Alliance, after laughing mockingly, all walked toward Lin Bai with a joking look and a comfortable look on their faces.
From their point of view, in their own camp, there are five warriors at the fourth level of martial arts, can't they even deal with one warrior at the fourth level of martial arts?
This Lin Bai is already dead.
"Stubborn!" Lin Bai showed his spirit-slaying sword!
"Kill!"
"Heihu takes out his heart!"
"Bull punch!"
"Autumn Wind Sword Technique!"
"Sweep across thousands of armies!"
"Shura Palm!"
…
These dozen warriors from the Qingtian Alliance rushed towards Lin Bai as if they were surrounding and killing a monster.
"Since you want to die, I will help you!"
"One sword spurts blood!"
The sword light, as fast as lightning, spread among the crowd.
"Ah! Ah~~"
"Spare my life!"
"Hero, spare your life!"
With one sword move, Lin Bai instantly killed three fourth-level martial arts warriors.
"Rivers of blood!"
A large piece of sword light fell down, and Lin Bai killed all the remaining warriors under his sword.
After all, the Weeping Blood Sword Technique is still a ninth-grade yellow-level martial art, and its power cannot be underestimated. Even the bald eagle just now, whose martial arts cultivation level was a level higher than that of Lin Bai, still died in Lin Bai's hands.
One can imagine how powerful this blood-weeping sword technique is.
And the swordsmanship, boxing skills, and palm skills performed by these Qingtian League warriors are basically Huang-level first-grade and Huang-level second-grade martial arts, which are not top-notch at all.
After Lin Bai killed the other warriors of the Qingtian Alliance, only the man who was the leader of the Qingtian Alliance was left. He was not dead, but only slightly injured.
